notes.title: I'm Back, Week 1 Deal, Christmas Ornaments
notes.content:
Hey I'm back! The boys at Choice Provision have pump my body so full of cat-feine that I can jump higher, talk faster and run like never before! Bubsy: Paws on Fire is the game I've always wanted to star in and HERE IT IS!!!!

You lucky Steam Cats are in for a triple treat:

1. The Game is Great
2. You a get a week 1 20% Discount on the already fantastic price.
3. You get an automatic free copy of Bubsy Two Fur with purchase (only if you don't currently have it in your Steam library. 

Once you've played Paws on Fire - be sure to write a review. I hang them on my Christmas Tree every year, so I need A LOT of them.

Your Boy Bubsy
